body: Real S keybind, new PACKET_ARENA_STOP wire packet, arena_stop_unit(owner) cancels move+attack order in place, resets target_x/z to the unit's own current position. Applies to the whole currently-selected group via the same selected_or_self()/arena_owner_controls scope every other group command already uses -- a Tyler player with drag-selected clones stops all of them at once. 3 new tests, full suite + 10-bot stability green. Attack-move/hold/patrol still open, milestone stays IN PROGRESS. Commit 10faf25.
title: NORTHSTAR §24 Milestone 2: Stop command shipped (first of WC3 group-order vocabulary)
